Admin Overrides
Grant course load exceptions and allow enrollment in courses where prerequisites were failed
Course Load Override
ℹ Hard cap: max 6 courses per semester for all students. Within that cap — CGPA < 2.0 → 3 courses · 2.0–2.49 → 5 courses · ≥ 2.5 → 6 courses. Override raises the CGPA-based cap up to the hard limit of 6.
Failed-Prerequisite Course Override
⛔ Normally students cannot enroll in a course if they failed one of its prerequisites. Use this to grant an exception for a specific student and course.

🏷 Student Series → Plan of Study Tagging
Admin can tag a student series or individual student ID with the correct Plan of Study. The portal remembers the student-ID tag and uses it automatically in Student Enrollment and Academic Offering.
ℹ Fall 2026 intake Series 261 is tagged to POS 2026, so its first-semester offering is taken from the 2026 Plan of Study for each program. Older tagged series automatically use POS 2025, POS 2023 or POS 2021 according to the mapping below.

Course Management

📚 Academic Offering
The courses actually being taught this term — pre-filled from each program's Plan of Study, with sections and faculty assigned.
📚 Generate Offering Semester-wise from Plan of Study
ℹ Select the Plan of Study for each semester. For example, you can offer Semester 1 from POS 2026, Semesters 2–5 from POS 2025, and use POS 2023 or POS 2021 for the remaining semesters. The selected POS is applied only to that semester. Student counts are matched from the selected program's enrollment/series tags.
ℹ Automatic sections: if a course has 55 or fewer students, everyone is placed in Section A. If a course has more than 55 students, the class is split into two roughly-equal sections — Section A and Section B — automatically. Re-running the generator updates the automatic section rows instead of creating duplicates.
Generate offering from students' next courses
ℹ This looks at every student currently enrolled in the chosen program, works out the single next course each one is due to take (per their own cohort/series and Plan of Study version — exactly as the student enrollment screen does), plus any failed courses they still need to repeat, and offers only that real, currently-needed set of courses — not the entire 8-semester catalog. Courses already offered for that term/program are skipped, so it's safe to re-run as students progress.
📊 Upload Academic Offering from Excel
ℹ Upload the timetable Excel file directly. The portal reads the Courses sheet (not Rooms/TimeSlots/etc.) and fetches the course, faculty, faculty type, mode, hours, capacity, section and merge information. Expected columns: Section, Course Code, Course, Faculty, Hours/Week, FacultyType, Mode, Capacity, Merged, MergedSections. Section should identify the program, semester and section, e.g. "BBA 1 A". Faculty names found in the Excel are also added/updated in the system automatically so they appear in the Faculty dropdown.

📊 Upload Courses from Excel
ℹ Upload an Excel (.xlsx) file with columns: Code, Title, Department, Level, Credits, Seats, Instructor, Description, Prerequisites. Uploaded courses are automatically added to the course catalogue and offered in an auto-created Academic Session.
👨‍🏫 Upload Faculty List from Excel
ℹ Upload an Excel file with columns: Title, Name, Department, Rank, Specialisation, Email, Phone, Qualification, Courses. Existing faculty (matched by Email) will be updated; new records will be added.
